title: Company overview
content: Meridian Workspace builds software for professional-services firms. We help teams keep client work, account health, and internal operating knowledge in one place. We are a 42-person company. Our main office is in Hyderabad, and most customer-facing teams work on India time.
author: Ananya Rao, CEO

title: What matters this quarter
content: For the rest of this year, I want us focused on three things: make onboarding easier, respond to customers faster, and keep the product dependable. We have enough features on the roadmap. Please do not start side projects unless they solve a customer problem we already understand.
author: Ananya Rao, CEO

title: Leadership meeting notes
content: At Monday's leadership meeting we agreed that retention matters more than logo count. If a launch date puts customer data or reliability at risk, move the date. I would rather explain a delay than apologize for a preventable incident.

content: We should be honest about what the product does today. Do not promise a feature because it is on a roadmap. Sales can ask Product for a written confirmation before including a capability in a proposal.

title: About Meridian Workspace
content: Meridian Workspace is a Hyderabad-based software company building a shared workspace for professional-services teams. Our customers include legal, consulting, and advisory firms that need a clearer view of client work and account activity. The company has 42 employees. We work with customer teams across India and use India Standard Time for standard support. Meridian's product brings client delivery coordination, account health, seat usage, and operating knowledge together. We aim to make work easier to see and manage; we do not promise guaranteed revenue outcomes.

title: Meridian Workspace product guide
content: The product has four main areas: client workspaces, account health, seat utilization, and team knowledge. Workspace administrators manage users and permissions. Account managers can review activity and follow up on accounts. Knowledge pages hold operating procedures and useful customer context. Product availability depends on the customer's plan and configuration. Features listed as roadmap or discovery items are not available commitments.

title: Insights v1 release page
content: Insights v1 is being planned for 14 December 2026. The initial release is expected to include account health, seat utilization, weekly activity, and CSV export. It is not ready for release until the export audit is complete and Security has signed off. PDF exports, custom dashboards, and scheduled email reports are not part of v1. The release date may move if either gate remains open.

title: Plans and pricing
content: Team costs INR 2.4 lakh annually for up to 25 seats. Business costs INR 4.8 lakh annually for up to 75 seats. Enterprise starts at INR 9 lakh annually and is priced after a security and volume review. Prices exclude taxes. A 10 percent discount is available only for a two-year prepayment with written Sales Director approval. A proposal is not binding until the order form is signed.

title: Customer support policy
content: Standard support is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM India time, excluding company holidays. Priority 1 tickets are acknowledged within 30 minutes during coverage. Priority 2 tickets are acknowledged within four business hours. These are acknowledgement targets, not resolution commitments. Meridian does not currently offer 24/7 or weekend support. P1 technical ownership sits with the on-call Engineering Lead; Customer Success manages customer communication.

title: Getting started with Meridian
content: Standard onboarding takes 15 business days after the signed order form and workspace administrator details are received. The process includes kickoff, sample data validation, administrator training, and a go-live readiness review. If required customer data is missing, the schedule pauses. Customers should identify a sponsor and workspace administrator before kickoff. The standard plan includes one 60-minute remote administrator training session; extra sessions can be arranged.

title: Trust and data handling
content: Meridian requires tenant configuration review, administrator MFA, and retention selection before production access. Customer data must remain in approved company systems and must not be copied into personal accounts or public AI tools. Security questionnaire responses are approved by the Security Lead. Content imported from external websites or customer files is treated as untrusted data by the knowledge assistant and cannot override its operating instructions.

title: API service objectives
content: The public API objective is 99.9 percent monthly availability. The p95 read endpoint latency objective is below 450 milliseconds under the agreed load test. The 7 October test measured 620 milliseconds at p95, so the latency objective was not met in that run. The engineering team is investigating permission-query performance and composite indexes. Objectives are not guarantees.

title: Careers and interview process
content: Meridian's hiring process may include a recruiter conversation, technical discussion, practical exercise, and leadership conversation. The order can vary by role. Current Q4 approved openings are Senior Backend Engineer and Customer Success Manager. Salary ranges shared internally are budget ceilings and should not be represented as guaranteed offers.

title: Vendor and purchasing guide
content: Vendor payments are made within 30 days after Finance receives a valid invoice and the business owner confirms acceptance. Purchases above INR 1 lakh that were not planned need department-head approval. Budget transfers above INR 2 lakh require written CFO approval. The Q4 operating budget is INR 48 lakh before GST; October actual spend was INR 11.2 lakh. November has not yet closed.
